title: Civil War I (miniquest)
start: Speak to Adrasteia in the Falador Castle throne room.

recommended.t: Wilderness sword 1 or better for teleporting to Edgeville or activated Edgeville lodestone
Falador Teleport, activated Falador lodestone, or master archaeologist's outfit to get to the White Knights' Castle

kills.t: 144 demons in the Wilderness as part of the Gross Misconduct achievement (can be done prior to starting the miniquest)

steps.t: Talk to Adrasteia (floor 2 of the White Knights' Castle's eastern side). [Chat: Accept › Any]
Talk to Anne Dimitri (just north of Quercus in the Wilderness).
Kill 144 demons in the Wilderness for the Gross Misconduct achievement if not already completed.
Talk to Anne Dimitri. (This is done automatically if you already had Gross Misconduct completed.)
